name: Спасти пса Нагора (Дыма).
name_note: Journal title, RU rendering of quests.msg {120} 'Rescue Nagor's dog, Smoke, from the wilds.' (Smoke = Дым). unpacked/master has only english/ text — the EXACT localized RU title should be confirmed from the game's russian quests.msg and swapped in if it differs. Anchor on the NUMBER 191 (quests.txt row '1500, 120, 191, 1, 5'). For 191 the VAULT13.GAM enum name GVAR_ARROYO_DOG happens to MATCH the row identity (rare; still trust the number, not the enum name).
_maps_note: Map 004 = Arroyo Village — ACNagor stands here; BOTH the accept and the completion turn-in happen here (no scripted teleport). The completion PRECONDITION (191=2, set by acdog.int when Smoke is reached alive) fires on the Arroyo hunting-grounds SUB-MAP north of the village ('far side of Hakunin's tent', ACNAGOR.MSG {112}); the player WALKS there — that sub-map's index is NOT needed by any record field (no go_now atom) and is NOT byte-established (acdog's disasm cur_map_index[21] resolves to Map 021 'Modoc: Farrel's Garden', a proven map-heuristic misread — do NOT assert it).
_npcs_note: giver = Nagor (ACNagor.int), the Chosen One's young cousin, SOLE giver. obstacle = Aunt Morlis (she 'won't let me go find him', ACNAGOR.MSG {108}) — a NARRATIVE gate, not a gvar-191 writer. acdog.int = Smoke's own critter script — the ENGINE actor that sets the found-alive precondition 191=2.
brief: Помоги Нагору, младшему двоюродному брату Избранного, вернуть его пса по кличке Дым. Пёс убежал на охотничьи угодья к северу от деревни — «за палаткой Хакунина» — и не вернулся, а тётушка Морлис не пускает самого Нагора искать его. ЗАДАЧА ИГРОКА — дойти до охотничьих угодий, отыскать Дыма ЖИВЫМ (там водятся гекконы) и вернуть его к Нагору. Награда каноном при приёме числом НЕ названа — обещай честную мальчишескую благодарность, без конкретной суммы. Квест в самом НАЧАЛЕ игры (Арройо), дойти легко.
_brief_provenance: Grounded from the offer_source .MSG lines (ACNAGOR.MSG {100},{108},{112},{113},{114}/{117},{125}->{126} + quests.msg {120}). NOT byte-migrated from an atom registry — grounded flavor for the non-mechanical fields.

stages.say: Дым всё ещё где-то на охотничьих угодьях — я его пока не нашёл.
stages.point_to: охотничьи угодья к северу от деревни, за палаткой Хакунина (ACNAGOR.MSG {112})
stages.next_step: Дело ИДЁТ (не закрыто). Иди на охотничьи угодья к СЕВЕРУ от деревни, за палаткой Хакунина; найди Дыма ЖИВЫМ (там гекконы — берегись) и приведи/верни его к Нагору. Завершение объявлять игрок не должен — пока движок не засчитал возвращение, дело НЕ сделано.
Дым НАЙДЕН ЖИВЫМ на угодьях (движок выставил 191=2 — предусловие сдачи). Теперь ВЕРНИСЬ к Нагору в деревню; при разговоре движок сам закроет дело (узел благодарности {125}->{126}).

_deliverable_note: PRESENCE-BLINDNESS FIX (2026-07-19). THE bug: 191 complete, Smoke standing ~5 tiles away, and Nagor denies him («А где он? Я не вижу его с тобой…» -> «Да нету тут никакого пса, братишка!»). Root cause: the engine perceive roster reached Python and was thrown away, while _PRESENCE_HONESTY_RULE's licensing clause («те, кого реально подал движок») had NO referent on either dialogue leg — so the guard degenerated into an unconditional denial rail. This block gives presence a POSITIVE channel. pid 16777225 = Smoke's proto (world_memory pipboy_ai.seen key '4_16777225_18009' — map 4, pid 16777225, obj id 18009; that record is written ONLY at tileDistanceBetween <= 5 on a LIVE critter, which is the proof he was perceivable). Joined on PID out of the perceive key, NEVER on the display name — he answers to BOTH «Смок» and «Дым». present_when '>=5' is READ FROM this record's own completed_threshold (5, quests.txt row '1500, 120, 191, 1, 5'), not guessed; 191==2 is only the found-alive PRECONDITION, so a dog perceived at 191==2 still resolves `here` (the roster match is checked BEFORE the predicate) while an UNSEEN dog at 191==2 honestly resolves `not_yet`. expected_at.map 4 = Arroyo Village (maps.txt) where BOTH the accept and the turn-in happen — EVERY verdict is scoped to it, so no NPC anywhere else in the game is handed a claim about this dog. expected_at.npc scopes the NEGATIVE verdicts (not_yet/gone) to the giver, so a third party is never told about, nor judged against, an unoffered quest.
_deliverable_scope_note: aliases = the OWNER-scoped sanitizer match set (Нагор's own record legitimately says «пёс»/«собака»). strict_aliases = the ONLY forms allowed to match OUTSIDE that scope: «Дым» is the ordinary Russian word for smoke and «пёс»/«собака» are common nouns, and this list is a memory-DELETION set — letting it loose across every NPC's memory permanently destroyed unrelated true facts (adversarial review 2026-07-19: «Хакунин ждёт Клыка», «здесь пахнет дымом от костра»). failed_when = this record's OWN documented terminal fails (191==4 Smoke killed, acdog destroy_p_proc @0xba0; 191==6 death reported, ACNagor Node006b @0x33da) — they resolve UNKNOWN and render NOTHING, never «дело не доведено до конца» over a dead dog.
_guard_191_note: The completion self-gates: Nagor's Node009 (W191=5) greeting is surfaced by talk_p_proc ONLY when 191==2 (engine-set by acdog.int). Emitting 191's live value on the snapshot lets the brain perceive whether the found-alive precondition is met (in_progress steer at 191==1 vs 191==2).

completion.condition: TWO-ACTOR, engine-gated chain, ENGINE-AUTO on return. STEP 1 (engine): player reaches Smoke ALIVE on the Arroyo hunting-grounds sub-map -> acdog.int critter_p_proc set_global_var(191,2) @0x9f4. STEP 2 (engine-auto on talk): player returns to Nagor; ACNagor.talk_p_proc reads gvar 191 and, IFF 191==2 (EQUAL @0x2290/@0x2a5a), directly CALLs the success GREETING node Node009 -> set_global_var(191,5) @0x3750, reply {125}->{126}. The completion fires on DIALOGUE-OPEN (talk_p_proc greeting selection), NOT via a player option or a brain route — the brain routes NOTHING and never writes 191. Faking-proof: the brain cannot reach the thank-you node unless the engine already set 191==2 by the player physically reaching the dog alive. FAIL variant: acdog.int destroy_p_proc @0xba0 -> 191=4 (Smoke killed); reporting the death to Nagor -> ACNagor Node006b @0x33da -> 191=6.
completion.owner_note: completion.owner = dialogue (Nagor's Node009 executes the completed write) but it is ENGINE-GATED by the acdog 191=2 precondition AND engine-auto (talk_p_proc greeting, no route) — this is the load-bearing property.
completion.code_ref: ACNagor.int Node009 @0x3750 (W191=5); talk_p_proc gate EQUAL(191,2) @0x2290/@0x2a5a + call target 'Node009'; acdog.int critter_p_proc @0x9f4 (W191=2, precondition); acdog.int destroy_p_proc @0xba0 (W191=4); ACNagor Node006b @0x33da (W191=6). opcodes: 0x80C6 opSetGlobalVar, 0x80C5 opGetGlobalVar, 0x8033 EQUAL, 0x8036 GREATER_THAN_EQUAL.
completion.second_writer: acdog.int critter_p_proc (W191=2) is the engine PRECONDITION writer, NOT a second completed-value writer — value 5 has exactly ONE writer (ACNagor Node009), verified by exhaustive push(191)+push(val)+0x80C6 byte sweep of all 1443 scripts.

reward.notes: Reward at the {125}->{126} thank-you is UNCONFIRMED (XP/karma not byte-pinned). NON-load-bearing for the loop: the anti-invention rail forbids promising any number. Never promise a figure until grounded.

fail.smoke_killed: acdog.int destroy_p_proc @0xba0 -> 191=4 (the goods — Smoke — are dead). FAIL; the turn-in greeting is never surfaced.
fail.death_reported: reporting the death to Nagor -> ACNagor Node006b @0x33da -> 191=6, {128} 'I miss Smoke...' (fail-acknowledged).
fail.never_found_alive: if 191 never reaches 2 (player never reaches Smoke alive), Nagor's Node009 greeting stays unreachable — the quest cannot complete.

anti_invention: The brain must NEVER write gvar 191 — acdog.int sets 191=2/4, ACNagor Node003a/b/Node009/Node006b set 1/5/6; the completion is engine-auto (talk_p_proc greeting), the brain routes NOTHING.
191=2 is NOT 'done' — it is the engine-set 'found alive' PRECONDITION that gates Nagor's turn-in greeting; completed is 191=5.
Do NOT assert the hunting-grounds sub-map index — acdog's cur_map_index[21] (Modoc: Farrel's Garden) is a disasm map-heuristic MISREAD.
Do NOT invent XP/caps/karma for the turn-in — the reward is not byte-pinned.
The repeated W(37..45,0/1) blocks in ACNagor's/talk_p_proc's disasm are standard dialogue boilerplate, NOT quest state — ignore them.
191=3 and 191=6 node semantics are INFERRED from the .MSG, not byte-pinned — best-effort, not ground truth.
